adaptations: Retain one Ngertiin lifecycle, SQLite receipts and existing per-run MCP leases. Read enabled grants immediately before dispatch; provider credentials never become a browser process environment.
Browser host owns one explicit profile, queues operations, activates the same native target seen through VNC, and keeps effect outcomes distinct from observation failures.

Use a private managed profile directory and a separate Linux display/RFB transport instead of Openbot Electron/custom stream. Capture and upload flows informed resource boundaries; arbitrary local-path uploads are not enabled.
excluded: Electron desktop/window ownership and native UI
Nous/cloud services and generic computer use
Openbot local-path upload scope and provider-side autonomous browser loops

browser_use.local_patch: infra/browser/patch.py adds full native session/target/tab binding to browser_get_state and Target.activateTarget after direct actions. Exact source anchors fail the image build on drift. No autonomous Agent tool, LLM extraction or CLI-MCP path is exposed.
browser_use.configuration: Private profile /profile, explicit localhost CDP 9222, headful Chromium and Xvfb :99. VNC separately observes :99. Empty LLM configuration, no provider environment, telemetry/version/cloud hints/extensions disabled.

stack.platform: macOS arm64 backend; Docker Linux arm64 browser

upgrade: Diff pinned MCP/session/CLI/config modules, review patch anchors and model-backed tools, regenerate the Linux lock, build and record a new image digest. Recheck profile paths, same-display/target RFB captures, native Codex/Muse images/actions, cookie/storage across browser/backend restart, expiry, grants, indexed freshness, stop, lost acknowledgements and no-blind-replay. Source availability does not establish acceptance.
